passages.text: REST APIs (Representational State Transfer) rely on stateless HTTP endpoints using standard methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE to manage organizational learning content.
Node.js provides a single-threaded non-blocking asynchronous event loop ideal for building scalable modular monolith backends.
Express.js simplifies HTTP request routing, middleware chaining, error handling, and security header integration in Node.js applications.
PostgreSQL is an enterprise-grade open-source relational database providing strong ACID compliance, JSONB document storage, and foreign key integrity.
B-tree and HNSW database indexes drastically accelerate SQL queries and vector similarity searches across multi-tenant tables.
pgvector extends PostgreSQL to store dense vector embeddings and execute cosine distance queries (<=> operator) for semantic document retrieval.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fuses domain document chunk retrieval with large language model prompts to prevent hallucinations.
Competency mapping measures user skill levels from 0 to 100 across categories like Beginner (0-39), Developing (40-59), Proficient (60-79), and Advanced (80-100).
Skill gaps are calculated by subtracting a trainee's current evaluated competency score from the organization's required target competency level.
Intelligent trainer matching ranks available educators based on skill alignment (40%), experience (20%), ratings (15%), and availability (15%).
Graphiti maintains persistent temporal learner context such as evolving struggles, learning style preferences, and historic goal progression.
LangChain orchestrates prompt templates, context retrieval fusion pipelines, and structured output LLM invocations across OpenAI, Gemini, and Hugging Face.
JSON Web Tokens (JWT) authenticate API requests using signed Bearer headers and refresh token strategies for secure session management.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) restricts system capabilities across Trainee, Trainer, and Admin user roles.
Certificates generate unique verification IDs upon trainee completion of course modules and passing assessment score thresholds.
Multi-tenant architecture enforces strict organization_id isolation on all database queries so Organization A users never access Organization B data.
Assessments evaluate trainee knowledge through Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), true/false questions, and practical short-answer assignments.
AI MCQ generation drafts structured quiz questions from uploaded learning material for mandatory trainer review prior to assessment publication.
AI notes automatically summarize uploaded course documents into structured key terms, summary sections, and key learning takeaways.
Organization analytics derive learning activity metrics, completion rates, and average assessment scores from real activity_events tracking logs.
